description: FlexiPivot is a powerful interactive pivot table visual for Microsoft Power BI that brings Excel-like pivot functionality directly into your reports. With intuitive drag-and-drop capabilities, multiple visualization options, and seamless Power BI integration, FlexiPivot transforms how you explore and present data. Why FlexiPivot? Traditional Power BI visuals require pre-configured layouts. FlexiPivot lets your users dynamically restructure data on the fly - dragging fields between rows, columns, and values to discover insights without rebuilding reports. Key Features: Drag-and-Drop Interface - Intuitive Excel-style pivot table experience. Drag fields to rows, columns, or values areas to instantly restructure your data view. No DAX required. Multiple Visualization Types - Tables, bar charts, line charts, area charts, scatter plots, pie charts, and heatmaps Built-in Aggregations - Sum, Average, Min, Max, Count, and Count Unique Values Cross-Filtering - Click chart elements or table cells to filter other visuals Native Tooltips - Full support for Power BI tooltip pages Data Formatting - Automatically respects Power BI format strings (currency, percentage, decimals) Extensive Customization: Style Presets - Choose from Default, Professional, Light, or Dark themes Table Formatting - Customize fonts, colors, and backgrounds for headers, values, totals, and grand totals Chart Styling…
